visual_goal: Show the offer composing the promise once, the reservation freezing it and versioning every change, and delivery, ledger and support reading the frozen terms from reservation events.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration. At the far left, five small wordless icons (a calendar, a price tag, a closed book with a bookmark, a small stack of coins with a percent-free plain receipt, and a wallet), none of which carries any letters each send a thin arrow into one green box labeled 'Offer', drawn as a priced ticket with a small timer. One arrow labeled 'guest confirms' goes from 'Offer' to a blue document with a wax seal and a snowflake, labeled 'Reservation v1'. One arrow labeled 'modification' goes from 'Reservation v1' to a second sealed blue document labeled 'Reservation v2'. From 'Reservation v2', three arrows labeled 'events' fan out to the right into three boxes stacked vertically: 'Delivery' with a small front-desk bell, 'Ledger' with a small open book, and 'Support' with a small headset.
alt: Five inputs compose one offer; the guest confirms it into a sealed Reservation v1, a modification creates Reservation v2, and its events feed delivery, the ledger and support.

visual_goal: Show the context map: partner dialects stop at the connectivity layer, the offer and reservation are the internal published language, shared services are open host services, and supply and inventory stay per marketplace.
prompt: A left-to-right context-map illustration. At the far left, a cluster of mixed speech bubbles with scribbled shapes, labeled 'Partner dialects', with one arrow into a vertical brick wall with a translator icon, labeled 'Connectivity'. To the right of the wall, a box split into a blue half and a teal half, labeled 'Inventory', with one arrow from the wall into it. One arrow from 'Inventory' into a green box labeled 'Offer'. One arrow from 'Offer' into a green box labeled 'Reservation'. One curved arrow from 'Reservation' back along the top to the 'Connectivity' wall, labeled 'delivery'. Along the bottom, one wide orange band labeled 'Open host services', with one arrow up from the band into 'Offer' and one arrow down from 'Reservation' into the band.
alt: Partner dialects stop at a connectivity wall; inside, per-marketplace inventory feeds the offer and the reservation, which sends delivery back through connectivity and works with a band of open host services.

visual_goal: Show Context Map v1 in three layers: each marketplace keeps its engines, both emit the same contracts, shared services consume the contracts, and Corvane Connect stays outside as one partner among many.
prompt: A top-to-bottom three-layer illustration. Top layer: two separate blocks side by side, blue 'Roomstead engines' and teal 'Nookaway engines', each with one arrow down into the middle layer. Above them, a small grey block labeled 'Place registry' with one arrow down into each engine block. To the far left, outside everything, a small separate block labeled 'Corvane Connect' with one dashed arrow into 'Roomstead engines', labeled 'partner API'. Middle layer: one wide green band labeled 'Shared contracts'. Bottom layer: three orange blocks side by side labeled 'Money', 'Trust' and 'Operations', each receiving one arrow down from the green band.
alt: Roomstead and Nookaway engines, both fed identities by the place registry, emit into one shared contracts band consumed by money, trust and operations; Corvane Connect sits outside and reaches Roomstead only through a partner API.
